description: How a project's reconfigurations are planned: 'weeklyCeiling' (at most so many a week without an administrator's word; null for none), 'requiredRoles' (team roles somebody on it has to hold — 'only with an electrician'), 'excludedRoles' (roles nobody on it may hold), and 'approvals' — weeks allowed over the ceiling. Any member may read.
